title: Structs proof of concept

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Please see discussion for more details https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/discussions/12753

It was suggested in dev chat that I rework my implementation to be pass-by-value with COW, and to submit a PR so that others could see the implementation https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/QTu9nG79BRxe8YyqD?msg=3PAfDaqLaFz4XYzn7

This implementation no longer requires the implicit Dictionary compatability, which means we can reduce the size of Variant struct to 2 * ptrsize, whic allows it to fit on Variant!

I didn't have time to get all the changes from my prior proof-of-concept (mentioned in the discussion) ported over to this new implementation, so this implementation isn't currently fully functional. For exmaple, it does not give code completion, and GDScript prevents running/compiling due to errors because it cannot determine what properties and methods belong to the struct (so you need to cast to `Variant` to get it to run).

However, the following works!

```gdscript
var raycastquery := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(<some vector3>, <some vector3>)
var castresult: Variant = get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(raycastquery)
if !castresult.is_empty():
    print(castresult.collider)
```

---

Full implementation and integration of Structs are going to be split up into multiple PRs. Current (read: rough) plan is as follows:

- [ ] PR#1 - Basic Struct Implementation
  - [x] Can declare/define the structure of any native c++ struct using a macro
  - [x] Native c++ structs can be used to construct a "VariantStruct" (name not final)
  - [x] "VariantStruct" provides for all the required interfacing between Variant and the underlying struct data
  - [ ] Unit tests
  - [ ] Any additional functionality required for VariantStruct to be functional in any other part of the engine, to meet the expectations of any other Variant-compatible type (e.g. serialisation)
- [ ] PR#2 - Full Struct Integration
  - [ ] Integration with engine API to allow specific native struct type declarations/definitions to be properly recognised as param types or return types
  - [ ] Integration into the editor Inspector pane (i.e. `@export`)
  - [ ] Integration into the in-editor documentation system
  - [x] Code completion + static typing + documentation available in GDScript
- [ ] PR#3 - Basic GDscript
  - [ ] Post-compilation struct definitions
  - [ ] Declaration of struct types in GDScript (`struct` keyword & syntax)
  - [ ] Instanciation of structs in GDScript (native and script structs)
- [ ] PR#4 - Advanced GDScript
  - [ ] Struct type declaration short-hand (syntax TBD)
  - [ ] Function-scope struct types
  - [ ] Anonymous structs (syntax TBD)
  - [ ] Construct with values (syntax TBD)
  - [ ] Struct methods (TBD)
  - [ ] Embedding structs (i.e. extending) (TBD)
- [ ] PR#5 - C# Integration _(note: I don't feel confident here)_
  - [ ] Ensuring can detect return/param types
  - [ ] Can instanciate structs and interact with all struct functions
  - [ ] (TBD) Can declare new struct definitions

Note: I have no plans to update any of the APIs to actually use structs, or to create any new APIs that utilise them. It is my hope that structs will eventually be integrated into these, but it will be up to the maintainers to decide when how and in what way.

Even if not integrated into any of the APIs, my PRs should allow for structs to be used in Godot projects.
